svg.title: Denoising snapshots of the plan canvas
svg.text: Denoising reveals the plan from the top rung down
Same canvas at five noise levels t. Grey cells are still masked. Masks are drawn deterministically here; training samples them.
Intent settles first, then structure, then the sketch. The AR model writes the text from the finished plan.
